about: Firefly sprint 05/11/2026, VIDEO part (Tu Tien). Firefly Video model adobe:firefly:colligo:video1 only, text-to-video, 1080p, 24 fps, 5 s, transparent background off. 3 takes per job, highest value first. Files: games/immortality-cultivation/art-src/lab/firefly-sprint-2026-11-05/video/<job-id>/take<N>.mp4 + take<N>.prompt.txt. Status is written by the in-page driver through the receiver (.local/ff-bridge/sprint-video-recv.py, 127.0.0.1:8841).

jobs.use: K6 sword rain SkyGate (sword-rain.ts GATE_FRAGMENT)
jobs.prompt: Anime xianxia game VFX element: a celestial ring gate tears open in empty darkness. A white-hot elliptical rim, a torn cyan corona of flickering light spikes, a dark aperture inside, star glints racing around the rim. It opens fast, holds strong at its peak, then closes inward and burns down into drifting cyan motes. No swords, no figures. Pure black background, nothing else in frame, no ground, no text. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.
